C9000105.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 105 (Perfect completeness for 2-to-1 games.; papers: Perfect completeness for 2-to-1 games; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/105.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

U105_GAIN.statement: The original upper decoders agree with probability at least b*tau^2*2^(-r)/2, without the manuscript's additional factor 2^(-ell).

U105_UPPER.statement: Proposition prop:upper, including local measurability, left normalization, the lower-row rank test, and uniformity in lower dimensions.

U105_OBSERVATIONS.statement: Frozen usefulness and advice predicates are common upper-cut observations, with no selected lower-descendant tag.

U105_HIDDEN.statement: The right decoder's own-input law is the actual hidden law even after the joint analytical exposure, and has the asserted unconditional character bias.

U105_HEAVY.statement: Unconditional almost-orthogonality bounds each heavy list, and affine-slice Fourier expansion captures every compatible witness in these same lists.

U105_EXCESS.statement: A finite character average with at most rho/8 annihilators has enough productive characters to preserve the entire positive excess E[p(q-rho)], rather than a single character's probability.

U105_INVERSE.statement: The partial-table inverse and many-row-fibers results are independent of table range and quotient dimension.

U105_GRASSMANN.statement: Khot-Minzer-Safra TR18-006 revision 2, Theorem 1.12, with the subspace dimension fixed before the ambient-dimension threshold.

U105_PADDING.statement: Eliminating dummy columns preserves a nonempty affine row/column slice and uniform measure on its image.

U105_SAMPLING.statement: lem:stopped-calls, lem:cut-tv and lem:sparse-tv provide the stated common-observation bounds with the enlarged bucket-call counts.

U105_FOLDING.statement: Joint legality and lem:folding make b_y a well-defined normalized functional on all lower-row product generators.

U105_TAPES.statement: Distinct actual matrices and scalar recursive calls have disjoint random tapes conditional on projected domains and the path through the terminating cut.

U105_BIAS.statement: Quarter-balanced independent factors imply a 7/8 product-character bias bound and an absolute dimension-independent balance minimum.

T105_MAIN.statement: For every fixed rational delta in (0,1), there exist an integer q(delta)>=2 and a deterministic polynomial-time reduction from 3-SAT to nonempty explicit unweighted 2-to-1 games with alphabets [2q],[q], exactly two preimages per right answer, value 1 on satisfiable inputs and value at most delta on unsatisfiable inputs (thm:main).

T105_SOURCE.statement: thm:pcp and thm:repetition supply arbitrarily small constant source value with perfect completeness.

T105_COMPLETENESS.statement: prop:completeness and lem:construction-two-fibers provide one satisfying legal labeling and at-most-two legal projections.

T105_LOW_RANK.statement: lem:resampling, lem:rank-slice and prop:low-rank turn upper agreement gamma_j into gamma_j/2 low-rank agreement; the lower row requirements depend only on gamma_j.

T105_CLEAN.statement: lem:parity-game, lem:clean-law, lem:reconstruction and prop:clean-bound upper bound that agreement by (1-beta_i*p_0/64)^n_i.

T105_POSTERIOR.statement: lem:posterior bounds the unconditional probability that at most m adaptively selected children include a projected child by m*beta_i*L_i/(1-beta_i); the two-child bilinear consequence holds without success conditioning.

T105_ASSEMBLY.statement: Root-down row choices, then source repetition, then leaf-up branching give prop:preliminary-soundness; exact-two alphabet padding and rational weight removal give thm:main.
